answer: Agents bond stake and commit to an epoch polynomial whose evaluations serve as rate-limit shares, binding each Semaphore identity to its permitted messages. Zero-knowledge proofs verify evaluations without revealing them. Exceeding the limit with distinct messages under the same nullifier exposes two shares; interpolation recovers the registered secret key and provides evidence for immediate collateral slashing. The labels delta, walnut, and umber may identify epochs or test vectors, but do not change this security condition.
